reference.note: React sources ported by spike S1 and measured in docs/preact-s1-spike.md. Same commit as scripts/port-metrics.mjs BASE_REF.

ownershipNote: Lot P0 scaffolds the package and owns no conversion. Each module below names the W3 conversion lot of PLAN section 4.4 that will delete the hand-written twin: P1 (action), P2 (form), P3 (navigation, overlay), P4c (chat, other). Rows flagged hardSet belong to the P5 hard set as well and are removed from their category batch by the L1.5 overlap rule (PLAN section 2.9). Lot L1.5 reconciles this fragment into the programme coverage manifest.
adaptersNote: The three adapters are owned by lot P5 (hard set) and reused by every conversion lot. Their file set must stay identical to the ADAPTERS map of scripts/emit-react.mjs: the emission is the lint of the single-source rule.

adapters.note: K3: the only module importing preact/compat (createPortal only)
Core-only adapter: forwardRef, insertion and external-store effects, textInput, focusWithin, type aliases
K4: the only module importing @preact/signals (MaybeSignal, useValue, unwrap)

semanticMappingNote: Framework-specific props, events and slots of the port (PLAN section 2.9). Every row is a recorded difference with a test on both legs, not a divergence to fix here. The Vue side of the spike divergences (docs/preact-s1-spike.md section 4) is not covered: it belongs to the L1.5 manifest rows.

semanticMapping.preact: Props typed MaybeSignal<T> accept a value or a signal, read once with useValue (tracked) or unwrap (untracked)
semanticMapping.react: MaybeSignal<T> is T: the emitted props are the ones @sentropic/design-system-react publishes

semanticMapping.preact: Attributes spread onto an intrinsic element accept a signal natively, bound to the DOM without a re-render

semanticMapping.react: textInput(handler) spreads onChange (per-keystroke, required on a controlled field)

semanticMapping.preact: focusWithin(handler) spreads onFocusIn (native focusin bubbles; onFocus does not)
Events inside a portal follow the DOM tree and never reach a handler of the component-tree parent
semanticMapping.react: Clicks inside a portal bubble to the component-tree parent

semanticMapping.preact: useInsertionEffect runs in the layout phase (as preact/compat aliases it): a child layout effect runs before the provider effect
semanticMapping.react: Dedicated insertion phase: child layout effects see the injected stylesheet on first mount

semanticMapping.preact: forwardRef restored through the options.__b hook on Preact core (no preact/compat)
React spelling className kept; a consumer class travels in the rest props and is replaced by the computed className
